d42_d43_gap_candidate.observation: A small horizontal two-lead rectangle is plainly drawn between D42 and D43, with a blank interior and no readable refdes at native pixels. It is a real assembly site, not a C85-labelled site. Neighboring D42/D43 package positions bracket it; the adjacent 114604420 and 114611058 panels do not add a readable label at this position.
d42_d43_gap_candidate.candidate_basis: C85 is the sole member of the C82...C93 collective bypass range without a secure individual assembly position, but that uniqueness is circumstantial and does not identify this unlabeled outline.

decision: Keep C85 source-modeled with provisional collective +5 V/GND rails and PCB placement pending. The unlabeled D42/D43 assembly outline and matching owner bare-hole pair are a prioritized C85 candidate, not a proved refdes assignment. Do not place its footprint or mark DNP from this geometry. A factory refdes/BOM or continuity plus a unique assembly attribution is required.
next_inspection: With power off, register the D42/D43 gap holes across both faces and meter each candidate near (2055,2235)/(2055,2475) in 200452717 to known +5 V, GND, +12 V, and -12 V anchors. Look for a higher-resolution labelled factory overlay or parts list to establish whether the unlabeled outline is C85 before assigning its PCB footprint.

owner_d42_d43_gap_candidate.observation: Both independent July component views show two solder-filled round through-hole features at the midpoint of the D42/D43 inter-package gap. Their common centerline and approximately 240-pixel spacing match the two-lead assembly outline after orienting the factory panel to the owner package row. No capacitor body bridges them in either view. They are candidate original landing holes, not independently proved C85 holes or power-rail joins.
owner_d42_d43_gap_candidate.limit: The body outline is unlabeled, no per-hole two-face registration or continuity has been made, and solder crowns alone do not identify population history or the electrical rails.
